claim: The newest migration that defines public.record_glass_pour resolves one glass as p_pour_ml, then the item's pour_size_ml, then the house's CONFIRMED pour (restaurants.default_pour_ml read only where pour_size_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL), then 150 ml (recipes walk G13, call F11; migration one_pour_size_for_the_house). Behaviour: supabase/tests/<version>_one_pour_size_for_the_house_test.sql T1 (125 ml house pours 125; 150 without the migration).
verify: python3 -c "import glob,re,sys; fs=sorted(f for f in glob.glob('supabase/migrations/*.sql') if re.search(r'CREATE (OR REPLACE )?FUNCTION public\.record_glass_pour\(', open(f).read())); s=open(fs[-1]).read(); b=s[s.rindex('FUNCTION public.record_glass_pour('):]; b=b[:b.index('\$\$;')]; sys.exit(0 if 'COALESCE(p_pour_ml, ri.pour_size_ml,' in b and 'r.default_pour_ml' in b and 'r.pour_size_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL' in b else 1)"

claim: restaurants.default_pour_ml is held to NULL or 10..500 ml by CHECK restaurants_default_pour_is_a_pour (call F12; migration one_pour_size_for_the_house; pgtest T5 refuses 9 and 501).
